title: The Prometheus rules alert when the kbmon adapter's scrape target is down
goal: otel/kbmon.rules.yml has an alert on up{job="kbmon"} == 0, since the kbmon alerts resolve silently once the adapter stops and its series go stale, and otel/prometheus.yml names that scrape job kbmon; --check-rules still exits 0 on the shipped file

run: import os, subprocess, sys; rd = lambda p: open(p).read() if os.path.exists(p) else ''; t = rd('otel/kbmon.rules.yml'); c = rd('otel/prometheus.yml'); r = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', '--frozen', '--project', 'otel', 'python', 'otel/kbmon_otel.py', '--check-rules', 'otel/kbmon.rules.yml'], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(0 if 'up{job=' in t.replace(' ', '') and 'job_name: kbmon' in c and r.returncode == 0 else 1)

notes: Review of SP-4f4m3noq (2026-10-22): the three shipped rules have no rule on the scrape target, so a dead adapter resolves every alert silently. --check-rules reads only kbmon_ names, so an up rule passes it untouched. Cosmetic: KbmonAlertHeld and KbmonLookupEvalFailed both fire on a failed eval, since kbmon_alerts counts the eval alert.
